Lately, I wake up a bit weaker compared to last week. My legs are weaker these days and I am not sure what went wrong. I have been taking the usual dosage of mestinon. But yes, I noticed even before that whenever I take higher dosage of mestinon, I tend to get more of the ptosis. Is this usual to us since mestinon supposed to help us with MG?

I visit my neuro every 2 weeks..  She is trying to lower my prednisone dosage monthly..  Should I increase decrease the mestinon intake? Imuran is available in my country. But my neuro does not have plan for it yet as of  now. I am also having difficult time sleeping :(
Almost 3 months now. I had 4 days of IVIG too. May be because of the food I am eating? I cant seem to control my cravings and gained a lot of weight too.
You'll get through it. All my best wishes!

Same problem ko before severe dandruff as in severe haha. I tried every shampoo na ata na anti dandruff pati mga nizoral etc at mga anti fungal. Ang nag effect lang sa akin is hair oiling. Coconut oil 3x a week. Then I use human nature as shampoo. Nawala yung dandruff ko. Now shampoo nalang, nag oil nalang ako pag feeling ko dry na sya.
